name: littlecoder
description: A coding agent tuned for small local models, built on top of pi. Exposed via ttyd for browser-based terminal access.

notes.text: Open http://<container-ip> in a browser; the first run launches the interactive setup.
Requires a local LLM server (e.g. llama.cpp on port 8888) that littlecoder can reach.
Browser access uses ttyd, which has no authentication by default. Restrict port 80 with a reverse proxy or firewall before exposing it publicly.
